msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia urban-fragance-03.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury beauty campaign still life of a minimalist round glass perfume bottle with a black cap and a white typewriter-style label on a slice of wood from the reference. The product stands in the right third of the frame and the scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Warm cinematic light, rich textures. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen or collage. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia urban-fragance-03.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Beauty e-commerce product photo of a round glass perfume bottle with a black cap and a white minimalist label from the reference, centred on a seamless soft blush (#F3E6E1) background with a couple of natural props (a petal, a pale stone) and a soft shadow, the whole product visible and large in the frame, crisp glass and material detail. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia urban-fragance-06.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Beauty e-commerce product photo of two kraft cardboard perfume boxes with a white label and a red felt heart from the reference, centred on a seamless soft blush (#F3E6E1) background with a couple of natural props (a petal, a pale stone) and a soft shadow, the whole product visible and large in the frame, crisp glass and material detail. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia urban-fragance-09.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Beauty e-commerce product photo of a Christmas set: a reed diffuser, a room spray and three small perfume bottles in amber, gold and white from the reference, centred on a seamless soft blush (#F3E6E1) background with a couple of natural props (a petal, a pale stone) and a soft shadow, the whole product visible and large in the frame, crisp glass and material detail. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia urban-fragance-04.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Beauty e-commerce product photo of a glass bottle being refilled from a tap with amber perfume from the reference, centred on a seamless soft blush (#F3E6E1) background with a couple of natural props (a petal, a pale stone) and a soft shadow, the whole product visible and large in the frame, crisp glass and material detail.
